Three areas to review.

Discuss your priorities ↗
01

Define the decision.

+

Start with the question the review needs to answer. A focused decision helps determine which information matters. Describe the choices you are considering and the uncertainties that affect them.

02

Bring the evidence.

+

Gather relevant plans, customer feedback, operating information, and observations from the team. Identify where information is incomplete. Keep assumptions visible so they can be examined alongside the evidence.

03

Agree on the next step.

+

Compare the options, assumptions, and trade-offs. Turn the chosen direction into actions with clear ownership and a review point. Decide what the team needs to learn as the work progresses.
